title: Receipt rule
description: Issues a numbered receipt from a series when a record enters a status.

whenStatus.description: Issues the receipt when a record enters this status

workflow.description: Workflow whose state whenStatus names; default the primary one

condition.description: Issues a receipt only when this is true for the record

series.description: Receipt series the number comes from

layout.description: Wording kept with each receipt this rule issues. The issuer, number, date, signature and void stamp stay as they are.

title.description: Title. Leave empty to use the series name. May use {{ placeholders }}

statement.description: Acknowledgement under the title. May use {{ placeholders }} such as {{ record.donorName }} and {{ receipt.amount }}

thanks.description: Line above the signature. May use {{ placeholders }}

rows.description: Lines under the acknowledgement, in this order. Leave empty to print the record's filled-in fields.

clauses.description: Extra sentences, each printed only when the issuer holds that registration

field.description: Field of the record type to print. Not a sensitive, hidden or long-text field.

value.description: Expression for the printed value, used when no field is set

registration.description: Registration type that must be on the issuer, for example 80g

text.description: Sentence to print. May use {{ placeholders }}; {{ registration.number }} is that registration.
